Figure 2:Agent involvement across three directions of video generation.Representative works branch from a shared video generation foundation into
agentic world modeling, agentic video generation, and development toward
recursive self-improvement (RSI). These directions connect video models to
sustained world interaction, coordinated production, and the improvement of
models and the agent harness. Vertical position reflects increasing agent
involvement, from No Agent through Agent Assistance and Agent Guided
Improvement to Self Improvement.
